# IBridgeAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IBridgeAdapter.sol)

**Title:**
IBridgeAdapter

Core interface for bridge adapters with shared functionality

Provides unified methods for bridge adapters. Adapters should also inherit from

IAssetAdapter and/or IMessageAdapter based on their capabilities


## Functions
### estimateFee

Estimate fees for a cross-chain operation (unified interface)

This method delegates to estimateTransferFee or estimateMessageFee based on operationType


```solidity
function estimateFee(
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address asset,
    uint256 amount,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options,
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 tokenFee);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination chain|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the asset to transfer (address(0) for non-asset operations)|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of the asset to transfer (0 for non-asset operations)|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (0=MESSAGE, 1=READ_STATE, 2=TRANSFER_ASSET)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`nativeFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the chain's native token|
|`tokenFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the transferred token (if applicable)|


### supportsOperation

Check if an adapter supports a specific operation type

This method should check both asset and message capabilities based on operationType


```solidity
function supportsOperation(BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation to check support for|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|Whether the adapter supports the operation type|


## Events
### RelayFailed
Emitted when a relay or messaging operation fails


```solidity
event RelayFailed(bytes32 indexed transferId, bytes reason);
```

### BridgeRouterUpdated
Emitted when bridge router is updated


```solidity
event BridgeRouterUpdated(address oldRouter, address newRouter);
```

## Errors
### InsufficientMsgValue
Thrown when insufficient msg.value is provided for the specified msgValue


```solidity
error InsufficientMsgValue(uint128 required, uint256 provided);
```

### UnsupportedChain
Thrown when a chain is not supported


```solidity
error UnsupportedChain();
```

### UnsupportedOperation
Thrown when the operation is not supported by the adapter


```solidity
error UnsupportedOperation();
```

### OperationNotSupported
Thrown when the operation is not supported by the adapter


```solidity
error OperationNotSupported();
```

### InsufficientFee
Thrown when insufficient fee is provided for an operation


```solidity
error InsufficientFee(uint256 required, uint256 provided);
```

### ReadChannelNotConfigured
Thrown when a read channel is not configured for a chain


```solidity
error ReadChannelNotConfigured();
```

### InvalidBridgeRouter
Thrown when trying to set bridge router to zero address


```solidity
error InvalidBridgeRouter();
```

### UnsupportedAsset
Thrown when an asset is not supported by the adapter


```solidity
error UnsupportedAsset();
```

### InsufficientBalance
Thrown when the contract has insufficient balance


```solidity
error InsufficientBalance();
```

### UnsupportedMessageType
Thrown when an unsupported message type is received


```solidity
error UnsupportedMessageType();
```

### SlippageExceedsTolerance
Error for slippage exceeding tolerance


```solidity
error SlippageExceedsTolerance(uint256 expectedAmount, uint256 receivedAmount, uint256 toleranceBps);
```

### Untrusted
Error for untrusted Stargate pool contract


```solidity
error Untrusted(string what, address from, address additionalInfo);
```
